If you’ve been thinking about selling digital products but don’t know what to create, save this post! 👇 You don’t need to spend months trying to figure everything out. You need a simple process that takes you from IDEA ➡️ PRODUCT ➡️ STOREFRONT ➡️ MARKETING. Here are 6 ChatGPT prompts you can copy and paste to help you get started. ⚫ PROMPT 1: FIND A PROFITABLE PRODUCT IDEA “Act as a digital product strategist. Give me 20 beginner-friendly digital product ideas I can create using Canva. Focus on problems people are actively trying to solve. For each idea, identify the target audience, the problem it solves, a suggested selling price, and why someone might purchase it.” ⚫ PROMPT 2: CREATE THE PRODUCT CONTENT “I want to create a [digital product] for [target audience]. Help me develop the complete content, including the title, sections, instructions, worksheets, and any additional information that would make this product useful. Organize everything so I can easily transfer it into Canva.” ⚫ PROMPT 3: DESIGN YOUR PRODUCT IN CANVA “Act as a professional digital product designer. Help me create a design plan for my [digital product]. Recommend a color palette, fonts, page layout, visual elements, and Canva template search terms. Make the design clean, professional, and appealing to my target audience.” ⚫ PROMPT 4: CREATE YOUR SALES PAGE “Act as a conversion copywriter. Write a compelling product description for my [digital product]. Include an attention-grabbing headline, the problem it solves, key benefits, what’s included, and a clear call to action. Make it suitable for a Stan Store product listing.” ⚫ PROMPT 5: ATTRACT POTENTIAL CUSTOMERS “Act as a TikTok content strategist. Create 15 short-form video ideas to promote my [digital product]. Include curiosity-driven hooks, educational captions, and calls to action. Focus on attracting beginners who would benefit from my product without making unrealistic income claims.” ⚫ PROMPT 6: CREATE A 7-DAY MARKETING PLAN “Create a beginner-friendly 7-day marketing plan for launching my [digital product].
